spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Teaching on the Image and Its Imitations

---

**¶1:** There are some among us who say that we [GAP-1: perceive (?)] that Divine Truth proceeding consents to the formation of that [GAP-2: merely natural and corporeal state] at another time. And further, the teaching says: Divine Truth displayed the form of the Divine Human throughout the natural mind. The self-derived faculties and the ruling powers of the natural mind perceived the form of the Divine Human, and they fashioned their own will and understanding after its likeness — which are the voluntary and the intellectual of the merely natural self. See, then, that the Divine [GAP-3: permitted these faculties to construct their external forms]. If Providence had not permitted the natural human to come into existence, the Divine would not have uncovered the form of the Divine Human, nor would the self-derived faculties have fashioned the natural self after that likeness.

---

**¶2:** Regarding Divine Truth proceeding — when it came forth manifesting the form of the Divine Human, it did not come so that it might reveal its form to the self-derived faculties of the natural mind. Rather, it came and manifested itself throughout the natural plane because of the entrapped divine life and the proceeding truth within, which is [GAP-4: bound within] every [GAP-5: state of the natural mind], so that it might enable that divine life to live [GAP-6: and be restored], and bring about its liberation — and to free the entrapped divine essence from every bondage and all the constraints of falsity and evil in which it is entangled and held captive.

---

**¶3:** The self-derived faculties and the ruling powers of the natural mind, in that they possessed no genuine spiritual form in [GAP-7: relation to] the Divine Human, lusted after its image. They reflected upon themselves and perceived that [GAP-8: they] had no [GAP-9: form or being] like the Divine Human in anything they had produced. They impressed the form of the Divine Human upon their will, within their interior life. Afterward they constructed an external likeness; they formed the voluntary and intellectual faculties of the natural self. They sealed the form of the Exalted Divine within their [GAP-10: interior life and will]. And so they copied it as an imitation; but they have not copied it in truth! Rather, just as [GAP-11: a reflection in a distorted mirror] is made to resemble the original, for it came [GAP-12: from the appearance of the original] but it is not like the original in genuine reality. [GAP-13: In the same way] is this formation of the natural human. They copied it against the form of the Exalted Divine [GAP-14: yet it remains merely an appearance without interior life].

---

**¶4:** Similarly the perception of truth — for while it appears like the [GAP-15: genuine perception of wisdom, it is] not a true copy in reality.

---

**¶5:** This matter corresponds to the following: As a noble, celestial affection of truth [GAP-16: dwells] within her [GAP-17: interior states of wisdom], rich in the goods of heaven [GAP-18: and possessing abundance of] spiritual goods; she is also beautiful in the beauty of genuine truth, and is virtuous in her innocence. She moves in a free and honored spiritual state. The fame of her spiritual beauty has spread through every province of the mind. She sur[GAP-19: passes all other affections in radiance]. Behold, her interior dwelling [GAP-20: is concealed from all external approach, accessible to no] disordered desire, because [GAP-21: of the protection afforded by] the elevated and noble faculties. Also, the self-derived powers lust after the beauty of her truth. They did not [GAP-22: attain to] her, because she is hidden within her interior state [GAP-23: of wisdom, sheltered] within a [GAP-24: sacred enclosure. None could] encounter that celestial affection [GAP-25: except through] the proceeding truth; or rather the governing wisdom — [GAP-26: that is, the covering of] external truth. This celestial affection of truth shall [GAP-27: not willingly] leave the interior state behind her and come forth into the external and natural plane [GAP-28: uncovering] her governing wisdom [GAP-29: and her inmost nature], and she reveals her [GAP-30: innermost truth and her spiritual beauty] because of her beloved — the divine good within. This affection of truth, upon whom no merely natural faculty ever gazed, nor did they ever perceive her true nature, as she neither desires nor delights in [GAP-31: external display — would not willingly] leave her interior dwelling behind her, and come into the midst of the natural faculties [GAP-32: where every power might perceive her]. And so all behold her. The upright faculties and the noble powers, even the lowest servile faculties, and the [GAP-33: most external natural capacities] look upon her.

---

**¶6:** In accord with this correspondence: Again, [GAP-34: this] too [GAP-35: is] the manner in which [GAP-36: the proceeding] Divine Truth becomes [GAP-37: manifest in the natural mind] — as this celestial affection of truth [GAP-38: comes forth, not] according to vain self-display, nor in the pride of self-derived intelligence, nor [GAP-39: because she] consented to the external natural world. She [GAP-40: came forth with reluctance], and she revealed her innermost truth and her spiritual beauty [GAP-41: to all who perceive], but only due to the constraint of love and grief [GAP-42: about] her beloved — the divine life entrapped in the natural.

---

**¶7:** Now, this too is the way of Divine Truth in its third proceeding, when it came and displayed the form of the Divine Human as an appearance before all the powers of the natural mind. [GAP-43: It did] not come so that all the self-derived faculties and ruling powers would form a merely natural likeness after the Divine image. Rather, it came because the proceeding divine truth was crucified — oppressed and rejected — throughout the totality of the natural mind; and it came that it might release that truth, free it, and rescue it from oppression. Yet when the self-derived faculties perceived the form of the Divine Human, they lusted after it. They fashioned after its likeness the voluntary and intellectual faculties of the natural self — the merely human will and understanding — without the consent of the Divine itself.

---

**¶9:** For, as with the will and understanding of the natural self, which the self-derived faculties fashioned and impressed after the form of the Exalted Divine, so too is this how a manifold array of derivative states, and many subordinate powers, and messenger-faculties [GAP-44: received] the impression of that Divine form which was displayed to them. For in the splendor of divine wisdom and in the love that radiated from it, they burned with their desire and were undone. They were consumed by their cupidity — as when a faculty of the mind gazes upon the splendor of a longed-for truth, and [GAP-45: is overwhelmed], and it is consumed by the {GAP-46} urgency of that desire.

---

**¶10:** This is also the case with those derivative powers: when they looked upon that majestic and beautiful form of the Divine Human, they [GAP-47: were seized with longing and sought to reproduce] the original form. They received the impression of that Divine image which was displayed to them. They copied [GAP-48: its appearance; but that wh]ich they copied out as a likeness was made [GAP-49: only into external and derivative imitations] — the forms they had produced — which had received an impression of this Divine image; and this impression extended inward even to the lowest sensory ultimates [GAP-50: and to the most fixed natural states] which occur from plane to plane of the mind. The {GAP-51} imprint of that Divine form which was displayed throughout the natural mind [GAP-52: pervaded all levels, and] they received its impression — it being revealed there as an image stamped upon the memory.

---

**¶11:** Now, this new spiritual birth that these faculties begot in a new [GAP-53: formation] in the natural plane is the will and understanding of the regenerating human self. [GAP-54: There is not a] form in the lower planes of the mind since the beginning that is like it; because that form of the Divine Human does not naturally occur in the states below.

---

**¶12:** Not all the spiritual formations that have been produced were produced through the birth that arises from a displayed conjunction of truth and affection. Rather, there are other formations produced [GAP-55: by entirely different processes].

---

**¶13:** One of them is the monstrous falsity of the sensory plane — the "sweeping away" that descends from the outermost boundary of the natural mind — which the [GAP-56: Divine Good as the source of all spiritual life] discharged into the gathering of falsities. Its own self-love and self-derived reasoning fashioned it [GAP-57: in]to a spiritual form.

---

**¶14:** The second formation is the one [GAP-58: that] fell into the natural plane. It made the realm of falsities its womb — the matrix from which it took shape. Its own cupidity became its fashioner. It alone shaped itself into a nature, which is the root of spiritual death. Yet when it arose from the realm of falsities, it [GAP-59: came forth with the intent] to destroy the works of good [GAP-60: that proceed from Divine] Good. Immediately there was sent against it the Indestructible Truth from Divine Good — the great instruction of spiritual strength and vigor. This truth subdued that monstrous evil in the states of spiritual obscurity in the north. It has trampled underfoot and set itself upon that evil nature, holding it in subjection until the consummation of the age.

---

**¶15:** [GAP-61: The] third formation is the evil nature that fell upon the good of the natural mind — that which is firm ground. It fashioned itself into a false perception and embedded itself there. [GAP-62: This is] the new formation that was fashioned [GAP-63: from within, and it] manifests itself outwardly as though it were genuine.

---

**¶16:** So, in accord with their essential nature, these formations [GAP-64: derive from the realm of] falsity and evil; yet they did not come with the ruling self-love — the sovereign principle of all evil — into the natural world. Rather, their formation [GAP-65: came] about [GAP-66: through secondary processes]; they are composite productions of evil and falsity that have been displayed and made manifest in the natural mind.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There are some among us telling us that we [know and perceive] that the (Ambassador) consents about [tha]t f[igure] of flesh; he who shall be fashi[oned in the flesh] at another time. And next, he says: [The Ambassa]dor displayed his image in the un[iverse]. The rulers and the powers of the universe saw h[is image], and they formed their shapes after his likeness, who are Adam and Eve. Behold, you see that god con[sen]ts to its happening; because of this, he has displayed his image to the rulers; and they constructed [mankind after his likeness.] If he was not consenting to humankind, he would not have uncovered his image, nor they fashioned mankind after his likeness!

Regarding the Ambassador, the occasion when he came displaying his image, he [d]id not come so th[a]t he might reveal his image to the ru[l]ers in the universe. Rather, he came and displayed to the universe be[cause of h]is soul and his son, who is [mixed in] every [place], that he might enable him to live [again] and make for him a release; and to free (the soul) from every bond and all the fetters, in which it is entangled and bound.

The rulers and the authorities, in that they had no form in [the likeness of] him, they lusted for his image. They reflected upon themselves, that [they] had no [form] like him in their creation. They sealed hi[s im]a[g]e in their heart, within their soul. Afterward[s, they] built it according to his likeness; they formed Adam and [Ev]e. They sealed the image of the exalted one in their [soul]. So, they [co]pied with an imitation; but they have not [copied i]n truth! Rather, just as [an image that is seen in water,] it is made as these, for [i]t came [from the likeness] but it is not l[ik]e him in truth. [Again, so too] is this figure of ma[nkind. They copi]ed it against the image of the exalted one [but not in truth]
Similarly the [t]ree, for while it is like the [image, it is] not [copi]ed in truth.

This matt[er is comparable to] this: As a great, fre[e] woman [who dwells] within her [palace, and she is] rich in wealth [and many] po[ss]essions; she is also beautiful in her beauty, and is virtuous in her modesty. She walks in a free and reputable position. The fame of her beauty has spread in every c[i]ty. She sur[passes every woman] Behold h[er] chamber [is closed to every] one who is mad, because [of] the nobles and the great ones. Al[so], they lust for her beautiful face. They did not [reach] her, because she is hidden in her palace [and guarded] within in a [secret place. None could] meet that woman [except through] his so[n]; or rather the head [covering of]hat garment. This free woman shall [not willingly] leave the cha[mber] behind her and come to the street [and uncover] her head [and her veil] and she reveals her [face and her beauty to all] because of her beloved broth[er]. This wom[an], on whom no man ever looked, nor did they ever see her fa[ce], as she neither desires nor rejoices [in outward display. She would not] leave her chamber behind her, and come in the midst of mankind [that all might see her] and everyone view her. The hones[t] men and the nobles, even the servants too, and the [lowly ones] look at her.

In accord with this simile: Again, [this] too [is] how [it is that] the Ambassador becomes [manifest in the universe] as this free woman [came forth, not] according to wantonness, in pride, nor [because she co]nsented to the outer world, she [came forth from her chamber with grief], she revealed her face and her [beau]ty [to all] but only due to the constraint of grief [about] her [bel]ov[ed one].

Now, this too is the way of the Third Ambassador, when he came and display[ed his] image with a show towards all the powers. [He did] not [co]me so that all the rulers and the author[it]ies would sculpt a form [after h]is likeness. R[ather], he came because of his son being crucified in the totality; [fo]r he would release him, free him, and rescue him from oppres-sion. Yet, when the rulers looked o[n] him, [th]ey lusted for his image. They fashioned after his [like]ness Adam and Eve, without the consent of the gre[at]ness.

For, [a]s with Adam and Eve, whom the rulers fashioned and [se]aled after the image of the exalted one, so too this [i]s how a manifold divinity and many powers and angels [also received] the stamp of that image, which was displayed to them. For, in the majesty of the l[ig]ht and (the image's) love, they glowed with their desire and they were undone. Th[ey] were eager for their lust; like a m[an who looks] to the majesty of a lusted after face, and [is undone] and he is eager for the [fire] of the desire.

This is [als]o the case with those powers, when they looked on that majestic and beautiful [imag]e, they () [lusted for] a first image. They received the stamp of th[at image], which was displayed to them. They copied [its appearance, but that]ich th[ey co]pied out in a likeness, it being made [into outward forms, not in truth. And] the ones that they had put forth, which had received a [stamp of this im]age; but inward even to the rocks [and the stones of the earth,] which occur from place to place. The [stamp] of that image, which was displayed in the universe [spread to all, and] they received a stamp, it being revealed there, and an impress.

Now, this new birth that they begot in a new [form] in the world, is Adam and Eve. [There is not a] form in their world since the beginning like it; because that [im]age [occ]urs not in the worlds b[el]ow.
Not all the figures that have been fashioned were fashioned by birth from displayed intercourse. Rather, there are other figures fashioned [in another way]
One of them is the sea [gi]ant, the 'sweeping' from the sphere, which the [Father] of Life discharged into the sea. Its own fire and thought fashioned it [in] a figure.

The second figure is the one [that] fell to the earth. It made the sea its womb. Its own l[us]t became its sculptor. It alone fashioned it to a nature, which is the root of death. Yet, when it came up from the sea, it [rose up] that it might destroy the works [of the Father] of Life. They immediately sent against it the Adamant of Light, the great 'instruction of vigour'. He humbled it in the districts of the north. He has trampled underfoot and set h[im]self upon it, until the end of the world.
[The] third figure is the nature that fell on wh[at] is dr[y. It] fashioned the tree and set itself there. [This is the] new figure that was fashioned [from within, and it]isplays.

So, in accord with the essence they [are of]ness; but yet th[ey] did not come with the King of Dark[ness to the wo]rld. Rather, their fashioning [came] about [by other means, and] they are composite and have been displayed in the world.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading indicates "perceive" and the editor tentatively reads "know"; combining both captures the full sense of apprehending that the Ambassador consents.
Completes "fashioned in the flesh," corresponding to the spiritual reading's "merely natural and corporeal state" — the figure of flesh mentioned in the preceding clause.
The surrounding text repeatedly states the rulers fashioned mankind after the Ambassador's likeness; this medium gap echoes that same construction before the conditional clause.

Standard Kephalaia term for the entrapped Living Soul scattered throughout matter; the spiritual reading says "bound within," and "mixed in" is the characteristic Manichaean expression for this entrapment.
The spiritual reading says "state of the natural mind," which in Kephalaia cosmological language corresponds to "place" — the soul is mixed in every place of the universe.
The spiritual reading says "and be restored"; "live again" captures the restoration to life of the entrapped soul in the Kephalaia's natural register.
The spiritual reading says "in relation to"; in Kephalaia language focused on likeness and image, "no form in the likeness of him" captures the rulers' lack of any comparable form.
The editor's "they" is confirmed; the rulers reflected upon themselves and found that they had no comparable form — "they" is the natural subject.
The spiritual reading says "form or being"; the entire chapter concerns forms and images being copied, and "they had no form like him" fits the thematic emphasis better than the editor's "one."
Confirmed; the spiritual reading says "interior life and will," and "soul" in the Kephalaia encompasses the interior life, paralleling the earlier "in their heart, within their soul."

fills.fill: an image that is seen in water,
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "a reflection in a distorted mirror"; in ancient cosmological teaching, a water reflection is the standard metaphor for an appearance that resembles an original but lacks its genuine substance.

The spiritual reading says "from the appearance of the original"; in the Kephalaia register, "from the likeness" indicates the copy originated from the outer appearance of the original but is not identical to it.
Confirmed; the spiritual reading says "In the same way," and "Again, so too" is the standard Kephalaia transitional phrase introducing a parallel illustration.

The spiritual reading says "yet it remains merely an appearance without interior life"; "but not in truth" is the refrain repeated throughout this passage contrasting genuine form with mere imitation.

The spiritual reading says "genuine perception of wisdom"; the tree appears like the divine image (the central subject of the chapter) but is not a true copy — "like the image, it is not copied in truth."
The spiritual reading says "dwells"; the parable introduces the free woman as one who dwells within her interior state, and "who dwells" connects her to her abode.

The spiritual reading says "interior states of wisdom"; in the parable, "palace" is the natural-plane term for her interior dwelling (used later as "hidden in her palace"), and the gap transitions to her wealth.
The spiritual reading says "and possessing abundance of"; "and many" connects "rich in wealth" to "possessions," expressing abundance in the Kephalaia's parable register.
Completes "surpasses every woman"; the spiritual reading says "passes all other affections in radiance," which in the parable maps to surpassing every other woman in beauty.
The spiritual reading says "is concealed from all external approach, accessible to no"; the chamber is closed to every disordered intruder, connecting to "one who is mad" that follows.
Confirmed; the spiritual reading says "of the protection afforded by," and the simple preposition "of" connects "because" to "the nobles and the great ones" who guard her.
The spiritual reading says "attain to"; "reach" is the natural Kephalaia equivalent — the lustful powers could not reach her because she is hidden in her palace.
The spiritual reading says "of wisdom, sheltered"; in the parable, "and guarded" expresses the protective concealment of the woman within her palace.
The spiritual reading says "sacred enclosure. None could"; the woman is within a secret place, and none could meet her — transitioning to the clause about access only through the son.
The spiritual reading says "except through"; access to the free woman is only through the son (the proceeding truth), establishing the mediating role.
The spiritual reading says "that is, the covering of external truth"; "the head covering of that garment" identifies the head-veil as the outer garment — the surviving "t" + "hat" forms "that."
The spiritual reading says "not willingly"; the free woman leaves her chamber against her own natural inclination, emphasizing the reluctance central to the parable's meaning.
The spiritual reading says "uncovering"; the woman comes to the street and uncovers her head, the natural action corresponding to revealing her governing wisdom.
The spiritual reading says "and her inmost nature"; in the parable, the veil over the head represents the covering of the inmost nature, which must be removed before the face is revealed.

fills.fill: face and her beauty to all
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "innermost truth and her spiritual beauty"; "face and her beauty" is partially readable, and "to all" completes the phrase, paralleling GAP-41's "to all" in the interpretive section.

fills.fill: in outward display. She would not
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "external display — would not willingly"; the woman neither desires nor rejoices in outward display, and she would not leave her chamber — expressing her essential reluctance.
The spiritual reading says "where every power might perceive her"; this purpose clause sets up the result "and everyone view her" in the Kephalaia's characteristically repetitive style.
The spiritual reading says "most external natural capacities"; after nobles and servants, "lowly ones" represents the lowest social rank in the parable's descending hierarchy of observers.
Confirmed; the demonstrative "this" introduces the application of the simile to the Ambassador, matching the Kephalaia's standard formula "Again, this too is how..."
Confirmed; the copula "is" completes the standard Kephalaia interpretive formula "this too is how."
The spiritual reading says "the proceeding"; in the Kephalaia's expository register, "how it is that the Ambassador becomes" is a standard explanatory construction introducing the interpretation.
The spiritual reading says "manifest in the natural mind"; in Kephalaia cosmological language, "manifest in the universe" parallels the earlier "displayed his image in the universe."
The spiritual reading says "comes forth, not"; the Ambassador/free woman came forth, but not according to wantonness — "not" survives as the last word of the gap, negating what follows.

The spiritual reading says "because she"; "because" fills the missing text before the surviving "she co-" which combines with "-nsented" outside the gap to form "because she consented to the outer world."

fills.fill: came forth from her chamber with grief
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "came forth with reluctance"; paralleling the parable where the woman reluctantly leaves her chamber, this fills the medium gap describing the Ambassador's grieved emergence.
The spiritual reading says "to all who perceive"; "to all" completes the revelation — she revealed her beauty to all, paralleling the parable's public disclosure.
Confirmed; the preposition "about" connects "grief" to "her beloved one," expressing the cause of the Ambassador's reluctant emergence.
Confirmed; "He did not come" restates the central teaching that the Third Ambassador's purpose was not to provide a model for the rulers' imitation.
The spiritual reading says "received"; "also" extends the principle from Adam and Eve to the manifold powers and angels who likewise received the stamp of the image.
The spiritual reading says "is overwhelmed"; "is undone" echoes the earlier "they were undone" in ¶9, maintaining the chapter's vocabulary for the dissolving effect of the desired image.
The spiritual reading says "urgency"; in Kephalaia language, "fire" is the standard term for the burning urgency of desire — "the fire of the desire" is a characteristic Manichaean expression.
The spiritual reading says "were seized with longing and sought to reproduce"; "lusted for" is the chapter's consistent term for the powers' covetous response to the displayed image.
The spiritual reading says "its appearance; but that which"; the powers copied the outward appearance, but that which they copied was merely a likeness — surviving "wh" + "ich" forms "which."

fills.fill: into outward forms, not in truth. And
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "only into external and derivative imitations"; "into outward forms, not in truth" echoes the chapter's persistent refrain about copies lacking genuine reality, and "And" transitions to the appositional clause identifying the derivative forms.

fills.fill: and the stones of the earth,
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "and to the most fixed natural states"; after "rocks," the natural Kephalaia extension descends to "stones of the earth" — the most embedded mineral forms that occur from place to place across the material world.
The spiritual reading says "imprint"; "stamp" is the consistent Kephalaia term used throughout this chapter for the impressed likeness of the divine image.
The spiritual reading says "pervaded all levels, and"; the stamp of the divine image spread throughout all places of the universe, and they received it everywhere.
The spiritual reading says "formation"; "a new birth in a new form" describes the unprecedented creation of Adam and Eve in a form never before seen in the world.
Confirmed; "There is not a form in their world since the beginning like it" states the unprecedented nature of this new creation.
The spiritual reading says "by entirely different processes"; "in another way" introduces the alternative modes of formation distinct from the birth through displayed intercourse.
Confirmed; "Father of Life" is the standard Manichaean divine figure corresponding to the spiritual reading's "Divine Good as the source of all spiritual life."
Confirmed; "fashioned it in a figure" describes the self-generated formation of the sea giant through its own fire and thought.
Confirmed; "the one that fell to the earth" introduces the second figure with a standard relative clause.
The spiritual reading says "came forth with the intent"; "rose up" captures the aggressive emergence from the sea, distinct from the earlier "came up" and conveying hostile intent.
The spiritual reading says "that proceed from Divine Good"; "the works of the Father of Life" is the complete Kephalaia expression for the divine creative works threatened by the monstrous figure.
Confirmed; the definite article "The" introduces the third figure in the enumerated series of formations.
The spiritual reading says "This is"; "This is the new figure" identifies the tree-nature as the third formation, with "the" being a surviving manuscript fragment.
The spiritual reading says "from within, and it manifests itself outwardly"; the figure was fashioned from within and it displays itself — the surviving "d" + "isplays" completes "displays."
The spiritual reading says "derive from the realm of"; "they are of the darkness" states their essential origin — surviving "the dark" + "ness" completes "the darkness."
Confirmed; "their fashioning came about" describes the secondary process by which these composite figures were produced.

The spiritual reading says "through secondary processes"; "by other means" distinguishes these formations from those that came directly with the King of Darkness, and "and" transitions to the composite nature.

assessment: 38 restored, 13 already filled, 15 editorial reviewed (14 confirmed, 1 corrected)
